description: Audit of KC21's 'the structural parity statement (S(-eps) = -S(eps)) ... is convention-immune' sentence (registry section 9g, PR #5107), which was asserted rather than measured. Route 1: the c_3 extractor is complexified (with the signed analytic branch of Q_A) and the parity re-derived under convention D -- it HOLDS, to 1e-45 relative over eight decades of eps, even though the D frame moves the value by ~972 (470x |c3^C|). Route 2: the reduction -- every ladder ingredient (h, hbar, b, u, Q_A, z_C, z_D, cos) is Schwarz-reflective, so the composite is, so Im is odd in eps; the parity consumes only real-valuedness of z on the real q-axis, never its formula, and a control convention z_X in no channel has it too. VERDICT: the immunity claim is VERIFIED. Two corrections recorded: (i) the operative hypothesis is real coefficients, not bar-oddness -- the bar-EVEN Q_A has the same property, so the parity is not evidence for the bar-odd channel; (ii) the literal full-value reading S(-eps) = -S(eps) is false (Re S is even and nonzero) -- the statement is about the imaginary part only. Scope-(a): no convention adjudicated for the Q_beta channel (qou-b3nk), no C-conditional value revived, the bar involution q -> 1/q is a different question and is NOT settled here.
tier: structural-parity provenance audit (60-dps measurement + exact symbolic reflection; no fit; no wiring)

context.the_reduction: Schwarz reflection. Each ingredient is holomorphic on a conjugate-symmetric neighbourhood of the real q-interval around q0 and real-valued on it, hence f(conj q) = conj f(q); the property is closed under +, -, *, /, composition, sqrt on the principal branch away from the cut, and cos. The Markov parameter enters as ONE such ingredient, and z_C, z_D (and the control z_X) are all real-valued at real q > 0. The parity therefore never reads z's formula -- which is exactly why it is convention-immune, and why the immunity extends past the two registered conventions.
context.hypothesis_that_could_break_it: A convention whose z is NOT real-valued on the real q-axis near q0 (e.g. one carrying an explicit i), or one introducing a branch point / pole inside the conjugate-symmetric disc used. Neither C nor D nor X does; z_C's sqrt branch point sits at q = 0 and z_D's poles at q = +-i, both far from q0 ~ 1.11.
corrections_recorded: KC21 states 'bar-odd ==> odd in eps'; the Lean chain proves 'real coefficients ==> Im odd in eps' (fig8TraceC_conj). A11 shows the bar-EVEN Q_A has the same property, so the parity does not single out the bar-odd channel and is not evidence for it.
The literal reading S(-eps) = -S(eps) of the full complex value is false (A12): Re S is even and nonzero. The registry sentence should read Im S, or 'the decay projection'.

Revives no C-conditional value: c_3, (H1), [3]_q/25, J-hbar^2, S_leak and q*_S stay C-conditional per registry section 9g. The bar involution sigma: q -> 1/q is a DIFFERENT involution from complex conjugation and is not touched here -- in particular bar(z_D) = q^-4 z_D (PR #5107 A2) and the z_C full-bar-condition failure (PR #5111) remain open as stated. Per 'Defined residual != derived decomposition', S = c_3 + Vol(4_1) remains a residual of a C-frame extraction.
